purpose: Story-derived visual differentiation of Mina and Koharu, preserving their identities and the existing game's illustration style.

assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: character redesign concept sheet for an existing Japanese emotional 2D shooting game, REFRain. One original character MINA shown consistently in three views, not a new game cover.
Input images: 1 is the current Mina dialogue portrait, reference ONLY for her recognizable reserved face, silver hair, blue eyes and anime line/shading quality. 2 is her current playable sprite, reference ONLY for game-readable chibi proportions and hovering pose. Redesign her hair ornament and clothing deliberately; do NOT simply repaint the old maid costume.
Primary request: give Mina a distinctive design motivated by her OWN story: a quiet AI who collects people's deleted unsent drafts, returns their true words, and secretly wants permission to rest. Keep her gentle, reserved expression, young adult appearance, long silver-white hair, clear sky-blue eyes and elegant maid/attendant identity. NOT a warrior, nurse, nun or mechanical robot.
New coherent costume:
- REMOVE the large semicircular frilled maid headband. Instead one clearly recognizable asymmetric white folded-stationery fabric ornament, two overlapping angular folded tabs held by a tiny sky-blue seam, near the side of her head. It must read as a deliberate refined hair accessory, not a stuck-on sheet of paper or giant envelope.
- Smooth long silver hair, one broad flat side lock tucked behind that ornament and the opposite side left loose; a simple elegant silhouette.
- Deep ink-green almost black tailored attendant dress with softly squared ivory collar, modest neckline, small fitted shoulder capelet, long fitted sleeves ending in folded white cuffs. No armor, no oversized bow.
- The WHITE APRON is the signature: two offset clean folded white panels cross once below the waist like a half-open envelope, asymmetrical pointed hem, one sky-blue narrow inner edge visible at the opening. Tailored CLOTH with subtle fold seams, NOT literal giant paper props. Two small stitched draft pockets at the waist. The dark skirt is knee-length and has a restrained white pleated underskirt. Small controlled frills only at the inner hem, not all over the bodice.
- A small original rectangular clasp at the collar has an open folded-corner outline and a blue inner light; replace the generic blue oval gemstone and bow.
- Three tiny subdued coral repair stitches on one apron pocket add human warmth, no symbols from existing brands.
- White tights, deep ink-green rounded low shoes with narrow folded white straps. Everything practical, modest, graceful and readable as a small sprite.
Composition: landscape professional concept board on clean pale neutral gray background. LEFT: one tall full-body front-three-quarter illustration occupying about 54 percent width, head and shoes completely visible. TOP RIGHT: a generous waist-up dialogue portrait with the SAME face, ornament and outfit, calm attentive expression. LOWER RIGHT: one small roughly 3-head-tall chibi airborne playable version of the SAME design facing right; complete hands and feet. Give the three views ample separation, no overlaps. Tiny color swatches along bottom are fine. Only one very small name label 'MINA', no explanatory paragraphs, no pseudo-Japanese.
Style: match the supplied game's polished Japanese anime art, delicate consistent colored outlines, restrained two-step cel shading with subtle soft color transitions, simple readable eyes, no painterly realism, no photorealism, no 3D. Attractive professional game production art, NOT an elaborate fashion gown. Emphasis on silhouette and a few iconic story-derived shapes, not more ornament.
No magical aura, no weapons, no floating text, no branded logos, no watermark, no external character references.

Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: character redesign concept sheet for KOHARU in an existing Japanese emotional 2D shooting game. A production concept with one character shown consistently in three views.
Input images: 1 is the current Koharu dialogue portrait, reference for her warm amber eyes, gentle approachable facial identity, age-appropriate appearance and the game's art style ONLY. 2 is current Koharu playable sprite, reference for roughly 3-head-tall hovering sprite proportions ONLY. Redesign the hair color, hair silhouette, hair accessory and uniform details, not merely recolor the same brown bob.
Story: Koharu is a 17-year-old high-school student overwhelmed by school expectations. A small VTuber's streams gave her a place where she could simply exist; she carries a violet penlight. She tries to smile even when unable to ask for help. Her design should feel like an individual schoolgirl with a private cherished hobby, not a stage idol.
New design:
- Hair is distinctly muted blue-green / deep dusty teal with soft desaturated sage highlights. NOT brown, not indigo-purple and not bright neon cyan. Collarbone-length, parted with soft asymmetrical long bangs; gather the lower hair into ONE short low loose SIDE PONYTAIL just below the ear, held by a plum fabric tie. The other side has a face-framing lock tucked behind the ear. Compact and soft, neither twin tails nor high ponytail nor an unchanged bob.
- REMOVE the plain gold barrette. Replace with a small matte ivory folded-bookmark clip with a single violet inset stripe, a simple original shape readable at sprite scale, NOT a star, cross or animal.
- Preserve her warm amber/golden eyes, soft face and a slightly hesitant but genuine smile.
- Refined believable everyday school uniform: short charcoal-gray blazer with softly rounded collar and a tiny muted teal seam at the pocket, worn open over a pale cool-gray fine-knit V-neck vest and white shirt. A small narrow dusty-plum neck ribbon, NOT a large blue school bow. Dark charcoal pleated knee-length skirt with one discreet plum inner pleat. Off-white ankle socks and dark loafers. Ordinary modest student clothes, no fantasy uniform armor, no exposed midriff.
- She holds ONE short lavender/violet penlight with dark grip. A short personal violet wrist loop with a tiny folded translucent ticket-shaped charm belongs to the penlight and remains readable; no text, no huge trinkets. Her other hand lightly grips the edge of her sleeve, expressing the struggle to ask for help.
- The broad color balance is muted blue-green hair, charcoal uniform, pale gray vest, amber eyes and violet hobby accents. Distinct from silver Mina, amber Akari and indigo Rei. Do not give her a large bag or schoolbook pile.
Composition: landscape professional character concept sheet on pale neutral gray background. LEFT: a tall complete full-body three-quarter standing illustration occupying about 54 percent width, full hair and shoes visible. TOP RIGHT: waist-up dialogue portrait of exactly the same design holding her penlight, showing the hairstyle and bookmark clip clearly. LOWER RIGHT: small 3-head-tall hovering playable chibi facing right, penlight in hand, exactly same hair color, hairstyle, clothing and accessories. Ample separation between all views, no overlaps. A few tiny color swatches may appear along bottom. Only one small label 'KOHARU', no descriptions, no pseudo-Japanese.
Art style: same polished Japanese anime game illustration as the references, clean delicate dark colored outlines, simple readable warm eyes, restrained cel shading, subtle hair/fabric highlights. Age-appropriate natural anatomy and uniform. NOT photorealistic, not 3D, not painterly. Maintain the game's melancholy warmth and cute readable sprite design.
Avoid external-character references, existing logos, weapons, magic effects, aura, floating text, dramatic stage costumes, sexualized posing, overdecorated fantasy design, brown bob and gold bar hairclip.

correction.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Edit target: the supplied KOHARU character design sheet. This sheet is approved in overall style, colors, face, costume and arrangement. Fix ONLY the inconsistent side of the low hair ponytail in the tall full-body illustration on the LEFT.
The CENTER large waist-up portrait and LOWER RIGHT chibi already give the intended design: one low side ponytail and its plum scrunchie are on the character's anatomical RIGHT side (the viewer's LEFT in the frontal portrait), on the SAME side as the small ivory bookmark hair clip. Preserve those center and right illustrations exactly.
In the tall LEFT full-body illustration only, move the low ponytail and its plum scrunchie from the viewer's right side of the neck to the viewer's LEFT side of the neck, same side as her ivory hair clip and the penlight-holding hand. Remove the old knot and ponytail on the opposite side, leave only a loose face-framing lock there. Exactly ONE low side ponytail on the same side in all three drawings, no second knot, no twin tails.
Keep everything else unchanged: same muted teal hair, amber eyes, ivory/violet bookmark clip, charcoal blazer, pale knit vest, plum ribbon and skirt accent, lavender penlight and charm, body poses, expression, layout, gray background, color swatches, KOHARU title. Do not repaint the character, add decorations or alter the other drawings. This is a tiny hair-side consistency correction, not another redesign.
